visible.name: Widget toolbar visible
visible.description: Whether the widget toolbar panel is shown
visible.description[zh_CN]: 小组件工具栏面板是否显示

pinned.name: Widget toolbar pinned
pinned.description: Keep the widget toolbar above other windows
pinned.description[zh_CN]: 保持小组件工具栏在其他窗口之上

cardTransparent.name: Card transparent mode
cardTransparent.description: Use translucent card backgrounds for all widgets; independent of each widget's own transparent-background setting
cardTransparent.description[zh_CN]: 所有小组件卡片使用半透明底色；与小组件自身的透明背景开关相互独立

showCardNames.name: Show card names
showCardNames.description: Show each widget's name under its card; global only - there is no per-card override; while on, grid cells become slightly taller rectangles (cell height = cell width + name height - 4) so every card keeps the same width as with names off and only single-row cards lose 4 px of height
showCardNames.description[zh_CN]: 在每张卡片下方显示小组件名称；仅全局生效，不提供单卡片粒度；开启时单元格由正方形变为略高的长方形（格高 = 格宽 + 名称条高 − 4），卡片宽度与关闭时完全一致，只有单行卡片高度少 4 像素

debugMode.name: Enable debug logging
debugMode.description: When enabled, the panel writes detailed debug logs to disk for troubleshooting. Default: off
debugMode.description[zh_CN]: 启用后，面板会向磁盘写入详细的调试日志。默认关闭
